name: security-auditor
description: Register machines and run repeatable Codex-assisted security audits over SSH, with timestamped reports and per-machine profiles.

interface.shortDescription: Register machines and run repeatable SSH security audits
interface.longDescription: Security Auditor manages a fleet of machine profiles, runs repeatable security audits over SSH using a remote AI agent when available or shell checks as a fallback, stores timestamped reports, and compares audit drift across runs.
